about_the_game:
Descend into the suffocating depths of Echoes Beneath, a first-person psychological horror experience where your choices shape their fate. You play as Xavier, a sewer inspection team leader for the company, Briliante, weighed down by crippling medical debts. When faced with tough choices, will you stay true to your morals or do whatever it takes?

Voice recognition

Use your voice to issue commands and make choices as Xavier. Speak to interact with the environment, and deepen the experience. Your voice shapes his fate.

First-Person Psychological Horror

Your job seems straightforward: inspect the sewers. But with an understaffed team and an eerie discovery, things quickly take a sinister turn. A hidden secret exists deep beneath the sewer system. Through Xavier's perspective, you will share the psychological horror that he experiences.

Dark and Twisted Narrative

Uncover sinister secrets buried beneath the sewers. Every choice shape Xavier’s fate and mental state. Will you deceive, betray, or hold fast to your principle? Choose your path and face one of multiple endings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-6400 CPU @ 3.50Hz (8 CPU), ~3.5GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050Ti or Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek High Definition Audio
  • VR Support: No
